restrictions: Classical probabilistic 256-bit word RAM, fresh independent uniform random-word primitive, total computation on one processor.
One batch of 2^128 iid uniform 64-byte messages from a 512-bit domain; repetitions retained; no restarts or advice.
Complete fixed-IV SHA3-256, rate1088, capacity512, suffix0x06, prefix rounds0..5, all256 digest bits; one padded absorption block per message.

Groups of 256 independently sampled messages evaluated by exact 256-by-256 bit transposes and fixed-register bit-plane Keccak Boolean circuits, using only listed 256-bit word operations; all copies and transposes charged.

Last-round early abort: the 256-bit digest is exactly output lanes 0..3 (the y=0 row), so the final (sixth) bit-plane round computes theta in full but produces chi only for those four output lanes from the five diagonal source lanes (indices 0,6,12,18,24); no data path from rows y=1..4 or lanes 4..24 reaches any digest bit. The round-5 envelope drops from 18000 to a charged 7000 ordinary operations per group (actual 5824 = 2752 logical + 3072 placements), verified bit-for-bit (0/2048) on the exact bit-sliced transpose+round circuit against verifier/keccak.sha3_256(.,rounds=6). Adopts the bit-sliced 256-message construction, transpose network, radix sort and distribution-free birthday argument of prior-art commit 2f22596 (submission 11c46f4, 126.995, in review), cited as prior art.
Stable four-pass 64-bit-digit radix sort of full digest/message records, with initialized counters, followed by a distinct-input full-digest scan and two charged target verifications.
Analytical upper bound with infeasible storage, no measured full-width collision, no PRNG, random-function, differential or round-independence heuristic.
